summary: Manchester United plc filed a Form 6-K on May 27, 2026, reporting its third quarter fiscal 2026 results. The filing contains financial highlights including operating profit of £37.7 million for the nine months ended March 31, 2026, adjusted EBITDA of £187.5 million, and increased revenue guidance to £655-665 million. It discusses team performance, coaching updates, and stadium plans. There is no mention of any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. The filing is a routine earnings release with no special-situation catalyst.
